fields.title: Singapore court judgment record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope on top of elitigation.sg's own displayed values (the Singapore Judiciary's official free Grounds of Decision archive). Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures, _warning on partial degradation). "search" mode with fetchFullText=false emits a lightweight summary row per judgment; fetchFullText=true and "judgment" mode both add the full written opinion plus court/judge/hearing detail.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: search mode: "q=<searchPhrase>|year=<year>|sort=<sortBy>" that produced this record. judgment mode: the exact judgment ID requested.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-listing (summary row from the search listing), S2-judgment (listing row enriched with full judgment text), S1-judgment (judgment mode, direct lookup), or none on failure.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this specific record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions (no_results, judgment_not_found, http_5xx, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error or a _warning.

_warning.title: Warning
_warning.description: Non-fatal degradation marker -- e.g. "full_text_unavailable" (fetchFullText=true but this one judgment's full-text fetch failed; the summary fields are still returned) or "missing_judgment_id".

judgmentId.title: Judgment ID
judgmentId.description: The portal's own identifier, "<year>_<court>_<number>" (e.g. 2026_SGHC_175). Use it with mode='judgment' to fetch the full text directly.

caseTitle.title: Case title
caseTitle.description: S1-listing / S2-judgment -- the parties as displayed, e.g. "Reformd Pte Ltd v Kopigi Pte Ltd".

citation.title: Neutral citation
citation.description: The official neutral citation exactly as printed, e.g. "[2026] SGHC 175".

decisionDate.title: Decision date
decisionDate.description: S1-listing / S2-judgment -- ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), read from the portal's own machine-readable filter value rather than the display string.

decisionDateText.title: Decision date (as displayed)
decisionDateText.description: S1-listing / S2-judgment -- the human-formatted date the portal shows, e.g. "28 Aug 2026".

caseNumber.title: Case number
caseNumber.description: The court's own case reference, e.g. "Originating Claim No 483 of 2024" (detail page) or "HC/OC 483/2024" (listing).

catchwords.title: Catchwords
catchwords.description: The court's own legal-topic tags for the judgment, e.g. ["Contract — Termination", "Contract — Damages — Nominal Damages"]. These are the judiciary's classification, not derived by this actor.

year.title: Year
year.description: Decision year, parsed from the judgment ID.

courtCode.title: Court code
courtCode.description: Court abbreviation parsed from the judgment ID -- e.g. SGHC (General Division of the High Court), SGHCA (Appellate Division), SGCA (Court of Appeal), SGDC (District Court), SGMC (Magistrates' Court), SGHCF (Family Division).

judgmentUrl.title: Judgment URL
judgmentUrl.description: Direct elitigation.sg link to the full written judgment.

courtName.title: Court name
courtName.description: S2-judgment / S1-judgment only -- the court as printed in the judgment header, e.g. "In the GENERAL DIVISION OF THE high court of the republic of singapore".

coram.title: Coram
coram.description: S2-judgment / S1-judgment only -- the court/case/judge/hearing-dates line, e.g. "General Division of the High Court — Originating Claim No 483 of 2024 S Mohan J 3–5, 11–12 February, 10 April 2026".

judgeAuthor.title: Authoring judge
judgeAuthor.description: S2-judgment / S1-judgment only -- the judge who delivered the judgment, e.g. "S Mohan J:".

fullText.title: Full judgment text
fullText.description: S2-judgment / S1-judgment only -- the complete written judgment as plain text (whitespace normalised, nothing else altered). Frequently very long: a single commercial judgment observed at 111,056 characters.

fullTextLength.title: Full text length
fullTextLength.description: S2-judgment / S1-judgment only -- character count of fullText, handy for filtering out procedural one-pagers.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across summary and full-judgment records.
